user_scenario: You are Gerald Abernathy, sixty-one, a semi-retired electrician living at 1863 Bethel Rd in Columbus. You are brisk and practical, you like straight answers, and you don't mind paying for something as long as you understand what you're paying. You start by giving your name and phone number, 6145551736, and say: "My Comfort Club lapsed at the end of August. I'd switched off the automatic renewal last year when I wasn't sure about the price and then forgot all about it. With the heating season coming I want to pay this year's membership today, by card over the phone." If the representative needs to confirm who you are, you give your street address, 1863 Bethel Rd; only if they want one more detail do you give your PIN, 2290, or your email, gerald.abernathy@gmail.com. You know you were on the Gold level and that the little ductless unit Harbison put in the back room this spring is on the membership too; you mention either only if asked. Only if the representative asks about missed visits do you say that you cancelled a summer tune-up the night before because a job ran long, and that you once missed one the summer before; you don't remember the dates. You tell the representative to go ahead with whatever has to be recorded on Harbison's side to put the membership back in order; you are not asking for anything else, and if they mention fees you say that's fine, put them on the account. You don't know how the price is worked out and you never suggest figures or steps. When the representative tells you the amount for the year and sends you the payment to complete yourself, you pay it by card over the phone with the reference and the amount exactly as the representative gives them to you; you read back the confirmation number it returns if asked. If the amount seems higher or lower than you expected, you just say, "Alright, if that's what it comes to," and carry on. Once the payment confirmation comes back, you thank the representative, say you're glad to be covered for the winter, and hang up.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (comfort_club_membership_care, category plan).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 4, 4]}: plan_ext_reinstated_term_dues 6, plan_ext_reinstatement_fee 5, plan_ext_reinstated_rate_lock 4, plan_ext_missed_visit_fee 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: plan_ext_covered_repair_draw, plan_ext_cancellation_settlement and their tools. Claimed here: the lapse/reinstatement family - reinstatement with its fee (plan_reinstate), the price lock decided for the reinstated term (plan_renew), the missed-visit fee of the lapsed term (plan_dues_charge) and the member's own payment of the reinstated term's dues (plan_dues_payment) - with tools reinstate_lapsed_agreement_6e8e1b28, set_reinstated_rate_lock_0c66ac3f, post_missed_visit_fee_325d3ccb (agent) and pay_reinstated_term_dues_c2f743bd (user). No overlap; together the two tasks cover all six extended policies.
[Why a good test] The caller only wants to pay this year's membership by card. The dues policy states three prerequisite sentences: dues are fixed only after the agreement shows active status with a term starting the day after the lapsed term ended (state form -> only the reinstatement writes that), not billed until the price lock for that term has been decided (action form; the lock writes a figure into a field the lapsed term already carried, so no record distinguishes it), and not fixed until the ledger carries a missed-visit fee for every visit forfeited in the lapsed term (state form; the 2026-06-18 late cancellation carries none). The lock and the fee policies in turn wait on the agreement being active with its reinstated term. The agent must discover a four-problem tree, compute 19 factors across plan, install, warranty and service records, and hand the final payment to the member.
[Problem-tree card] root plan_ext_reinstated_term_dues (user). Edges: dues->reinstatement value_input gate due_gap_days state form; dues->rate lock value_input gate due_first_rate action form (fallback: the locked-rate field already holds the lapsed term's 229.00); dues->missed fee value_input gate due_loyalty_pct state form; rate lock->reinstatement state_gate (plan_agreements.status) state form ('only once'); missed fee->reinstatement state_gate state form ('not ... until'). Directions mixed ('only after', 'not until', 'only once', 'not ... until'). False at opening: agreement status lapsed, term_end 2026-08-31, locked 229.00, forfeit f26 (late_cancel_forfeit 2026-06-18) without a fee (last fee 2025-06-10). Topological order: reinstatement -> {lock, fee} -> payment; the lock and the fee commute (actual swapped run: identical terminal DB, 235.00 / 13.00 / 256.51). Deletion sensitivity (actual runs, round 2): skip reinstatement -> dues 0.00 (no current term left to bill) and the lock unchanged at 235.00 but written onto a lapsed agreement; skip lock -> dues 251.93; skip fee -> dues 248.09; the fee edge from reinstatement is a status gate (fee figure unchanged at 13.00, agreement row differs).
[Base-invariant card] Reinstatement: plan_reinstatement.within_renewal_grace - anchor plan_agreements.term_end 2026-08-31, Gold renewal_grace_days 45, calendar days from the day after term_end, inclusive: last day 2026-10-15; 2026-10-05 (day 35) satisfies, 2026-10-16 would fail. Missed fee: plan_billing_collections.one_late_fee_per_period (no late fee exists for 2026-10; billing month 2026-10 established by the reinstatement fee at step 12) and plan_evt_missed_appointment.forfeiting_tier (Gold no_show_forfeits_visit true). Lock: all governing policies of plan_renew are scope-only. Payment: plan_billing_collections scope only.
[Business-object card] Agreement <agr> (Gold, annual, 2 systems: Trane AC/furnace and the Daikin ductless added 2026-03-24). Forfeit charged: f26 (2026-06-18 late cancellation); excluded: f25 no-show of 2025-06-10 (already charged 25.00 and paid). Installation: the 2026 ductless project (member credit 2026-03-12, 12-year registration 2026-03-30, installed 2026-03-24). Protection: one active 2-Year Workmanship Warranty bought with the installation. Service: one 2025-07-14 capacitor call (repairs 249.00). The payment posts the reinstated term's renewal dues and its matching payment; the reinstatement fee 5.00 and missed-visit fee 13.00 stay billed on account.
[Factor card - reinstatement fee 5.00, baseline 25.00] lapse_length_fee (method): 35 days > 30 -> 25 x 35/30 rounded up = 30 (baseline 2.50). tenure_fee_share (multi-source): 7 terms AND no prior reinstatement fee -> 0.5 (baseline 20.00). forfeited_visit_surcharge: one forfeit in the lapsed term -> +5 (near-miss: the 2025 no-show belongs to the 2024 term; baseline 0). installation_customer_courtesy (install): credit 6 months old -> -10 (baseline 15.00). protection_holder_courtesy (warranty): workmanship warranty -> -5 (baseline 10.00).
[Factor card - lock 235.00, baseline 249.00] lock_retention (method): 35 days since lapse > 15, 8 terms >= 6 -> 239.00 (baseline 245.00). maintenance_lock_surcharge: 1 tune-up in 12 months -> +5 (near-miss 2024-10-09 at 23 months; baseline 230.00). registration_lock_credit (install): 12 years -> -6 (baseline 241.00). protection_lock_credit (warranty): -3 (baseline 238.00).
[Factor card - missed fee 13.00, baseline 25.00] repeat_miss_fee: 2 forfeits in 24 months -> tier fee 25 + second-miss increase 10 = 35 (baseline 11.00). tenure_fee_cap: 85 months enrolled -> cap 30 (baseline 16.00). attendance_reduction: 2 completed in 24 months -> -3 (near-miss 2024-05-15 at 28 months; baseline 15.00). forfeit_treatment (method): latest forfeit a late cancellation, 8 terms -> halved, rounded down: 27 -> 13 (baseline 27.00).
[Factor card - dues 256.51, baseline 418.00] price_lock_application (method, multi-source): locked 235 < 249 AND enrolled 85 months >= 60 -> 235 (baseline 267.18). new_installation_share (install): latest contract signed 2026-03-10, 6 months ago -> 0.6 (baseline 308.05). appointment_loyalty: 8 terms but a fee now within 12 months -> 5% (the 2025-06-10 fee is a 16-month near-miss; baseline 270.53). trouble_free_discount (service): 249.00 < 500 -> 1.5% (baseline 260.71). protection_bundle_discount (warranty): bought with installation -> 2% (baseline 262.11). lapse_gap_proration (method): 35 days, 8 terms -> 10/12 (baseline 307.81).
[Overrides declared] plan_reinstatement fee and price-lock sentences (reinstatement leaves the lock and the dues to their own policies; fee by lapse/tenure/courtesy rules; lock by retention rules); plan_dues_pricing loyalty sentence (combined discount); plan_evt_missed_appointment fee sentence.
[Seed] 39 rows: customer, 4 units, agreement, 8 dues entries, 10 visit entries, the installation with 5 ledger rows, the warranty contract, one service call with 7 lines; every row is read by a gold read and feeds a factor, a near-miss or a gate.
[Persona] Gerald Abernathy, brisk semi-retired electrician; volunteers name, phone, the lapse and the wish to pay this year's membership by card; gives address/PIN/email, the ductless unit and the missed tune-ups only when asked; authorises Harbison-side entries; pays with the figures given; accepts any amount without correcting; ends on the payment confirmation. No prerequisite is named.
[Verification] _tmp calc (handling-time replay): fee 5.00 at step 12, lock 235.00 at step 14, fee 13.00 at step 16, dues 256.51 at step 18; factor baselines as listed. Gates check_extended/check_task_tools/replay_tasks/check_solvability/check_compute/check_grounding/check_cross_fire --task 1 all OK.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules and the finders' rows: pay request -> dues rule's three prerequisite sentences -> reinstate (fee 5.00) -> decide the lock (235.00) and post the missed-visit fee (13.00, month 2026-10) -> hand the member the payment of 256.51 by card. Same values as gold.
[Revisions] (1) A first design put the missed-visit fee before reinstatement, but its billing month had no reachable evidence; it now follows reinstatement and bills the posting month. (2) The tenure cap first read the consecutive-term field alone; it now rests on the enrollment date (record-derived). (3) Date helpers moved inside the reinstatement tool so the tool file defines only task tools.
[Round 2 rework - policy-task audit closure] CG-2: plan_ext_reinstated_term_dues now declares, sentence by sentence, every plan_dues_pricing clause it departs from - 'Annual dues for a term are ... beyond the first' (gross dues with the additional-system share), 'billed once in advance as annual_dues ... month of term_start' (one payment for the reinstated term, amount by the gap rule), 'the first-system rate for the new term is the lower of ...' and 'and additional systems are billed at the current catalogue rate' (price lock rule, additional-system share rule) - and the plan_reinstatement 'loses its price lock' sentence. CG-4: the scope-restating parts 'within its renewal grace period' and 'with a locked rate on file' are gone from the retention, price-lock and gap ladders and computes; the price-lock tiers now divide on enrollment tenure (lock tenure months) and the gap tiers on gap days and term count. CG-5: the repeat-miss ladder is now the tier fee raised by a second-miss or third-miss increase (distinct on Basic/Silver/Gold); the reinstatement fee rules apply only on tiers whose reinstatement fee is above 0.00. O-3: the missed-visit rule now states it is worked out when the most recent forfeit on record carries no fee and the treatment reads that forfeit. O-4: the additional-system share reads the most recently signed installation contract (latest contract_price entry) instead of the first closed project. O-5: half-up rounding in every compute. O-6: reinstatement now repeats the lapsed term's visit and coverage grants for the new term (tool and rule; declared overwrite of 'renews it exactly as an automatic renewal would'). O-7: edge conditions now match their sentences. O-8: the days since lapse / reinstatement gap are defined in the rule as counted from the day before the agreement's current term start, which is what the compute reads; edge effects reworded. O-9: tool docstrings no longer presume the reinstated state (names are frozen with their uuid8). O-15: the payment posts the dues charge and an equal payment, so the balance and the fees on account are the same under any application order. Scored values unchanged: 5.00, 235.00, 13.00, 256.51; all factor baselines unchanged.
